title: Inoki vs. Masa Saito: from title final to island duel
summary: Inoki and Masa Saito contest the first regularly defended IWGP heavyweight championship. Their rivalry then leaves the arena for an extraordinary confrontation on Ganryujima.

chapters.title: The inaugural IWGP heavyweight champion
chapters.result: Inoki defeats Saito in the final to become champion.
chapters.context: This establishes the defended championship lineage, distinct from the earlier annual IWGP tournament crown.

chapters.title: The Ganryujima duel
chapters.result: Inoki defeats Saito after a confrontation lasting more than two hours.
chapters.context: The remote setting transforms their rivalry into an endurance spectacle outside the conventions of an arena title match.
